set_aside.subject: Archived-project progress listing and empty manual-budget creation
set_aside.text: “the progress list first creates the empty manual budget version when the project has none, an archived one included (R0-24)”
set_aside.question: Which budget-management capability performs this write for list_project_progress, and what authorization context does it accept for the exceptional archived-project read?
options: list_project_progress calls the existing budget_management.ensure_manual_budget with a progress-read context and the R0-24 archival exception
budget_management exposes a distinct internal capability for progress-read initialization, which list_project_progress calls
set_aside.default_guess: Use budget_management.ensure_manual_budget, explicitly allowing the R0-24 archived progress-read case and retaining budget.manual_version_create audit semantics.

set_aside.subject: Revocation visibility for an already-authenticated request
set_aside.text: A11 says “Immediate means every request authenticated after the revocation commits observes it,” while A4 and M07 say revocation blocks “the next project-scoped authorization check.”
set_aside.question: If a request authenticates before a grant or assignment revocation commits but performs its project authorization check after that commit, must the authorization observe the revocation?
options: Yes; the authorization check re-reads current access and refuses the request
No; authentication fixes the request's access state, so an already-authenticated request may complete
set_aside.default_guess: Re-read access during project authorization and refuse the request if revocation has committed.

witness.initial: An operator has a valid staff session and an active assignment to project P.
events: The operator's request resolves its staff session.
An administrator revokes the operator's assignment to P and the revocation commits.
The operator's request performs its project-scoped authorization check for P.
outcomes: The request is refused because the next authorization check observes the committed revocation.
The request succeeds because it authenticated before the revocation committed; only requests authenticated afterward must observe it.
witness.observer: The operator sees either the requested project result or an access refusal.
